title: The one thing Luffy can never do

scenes.headline: Luffy can't do this
scenes.narration: Luffy can stretch like rubber and take hits that would flatten anyone else. But there is one simple thing he can never do.

scenes.headline: He can't swim
scenes.narration: He can't swim. When Luffy ate the Gum-Gum Fruit, his body turned into rubber. The price? Like every Devil Fruit user, he can no longer swim.

scenes.headline: A hat with a promise
scenes.narration: His famous straw hat isn't just style. The pirate Shanks entrusted it to him as a child, and asked him to return it one day as a great pirate.

scenes.headline: King of the Pirates
scenes.narration: And his dream has never changed: find the legendary treasure called the One Piece, and become King of the Pirates.

scenes.headline: Which dream is hardest?
scenes.narration: Which Straw Hat dream do you think is the hardest to achieve? Tell me in the comments, and follow for more anime secrets.

caption: Luffy can stretch, punch and survive almost anything... except this. 🌊 Which Straw Hat dream is the hardest? 👇
